articles.summary: Atmos Energy Corporation (NYSE: ATO) announced today that Kim R. Cocklin, currently Chairman of the Board of Directors, will retire from the Board of Directors and from the role of Chairman of the Board, effective as of the date of the Company’s 2027 annual meeting of shareholders (“2027 Annual Meeting”) after distinguished service on the Board. He intends to continue to serve as the Chairman of the Board through the 2027 Annual Meeting. Mr. Cocklin has reached mandatory retirement age under the Company’s Corporate Governance Guidelines and will not stand for re-election to the Board at the 2027 Annual Meeting. During his tenure with the Company beginning in 2006, Mr. Cocklin has served in multiple leading roles including Chairman of the Board since December 2020, Executive Chairman of the Board from October 2017 to December 2020, Chief Executive Officer or President and Chief Executive Officer from October 2010 to September 2017, President and Chief Operating Officer from October
articles.title: Atmos Energy Corporation Announces Retirement of Kim R. Cocklin and Appointment of J. Kevin Akers as Chairman of the Board of Directors

articles.summary: Atmos Energy Corporation (NYSE: ATO) said today that its Board of Directors declared a quarterly dividend increase on the company’s common stock to $1.09 per share. The Fiscal 2026 annual dividend was $4.00. The Fiscal 2027 indicated annual dividend is $4.36. The dividend will be paid on December 7, 2026, to shareholders of record on November 23, 2026. This is the company’s 172nd consecutive quarterly dividend. Atmos Energy Corporation, a natural gas-only distributor, is an SP 500 company headquartered in Dallas. We safely deliver reliable, efficient and abundant natural gas to approximately 3.4 million distribution customers in over 1,400 communities across eight states located primarily in the South. As part of our vision to be the safest provider of natural gas services, we are modernizing our business and infrastructure while continuing to invest in safety, innovation, environmental sustainability, and our communities. articles.summary: Atmos Energy Corporation (NYSE: ATO) today reported consolidated results for its fourth fiscal quarter ended September 30, 2026. This news release should be read in conjunction with our earnings slides which are concurrently being posted at www.atmosenergy.com . Fiscal Year Highlights Earnings per diluted share of $8.49 on net income of $1.4 billion. Capital expenditures were $4.2 billion; over 85% focused on safety and reliability. Strong financial profile with 60% equity capitalization and $3.8 billion in available liquidity. Implemented $395.4 million in annualized regulatory outcomes. Outlook Fiscal 2027 earnings per diluted share guidance expected to be in the range of $9.05 - $9.25 per diluted share. Fiscal 2027 capital expenditure guidance expected to be approximately $4.5 billion. The company's Board of Directors has declared a quarterly dividend of $1.09 per common share.
